label: PATHWAY
conventions: shared-head coordination = ONE span (delete-conjunct test); partly-marked coordination scored as narrow-span TP + full-string FN
trailing 'pathway/pathways' stays in span; trailing 'metabolites/rate/efficiency/flux/genes/disorders/activity/function' excluded (FP, often with carve-out FN)
disease/gene-set phrase embedding a pathway -> span only the pathway part; disease-class terms (e.g. urea cycle disorders) are FP with carve-out FN
compound/umbrella metabolism terms (e.g. lipid metabolism, cholesterol metabolism) count as PATHWAY

rejects: enzyme/protein/PTM, signalling pathways, cell-death (apoptosis/ferroptosis), transport (ABC transporters, glucose uptake), phenotype (insulin resistance), bare compounds, named phenomena (Warburg effect), chemical-compound synthesis, protein synthesis/translation
